description.text: Core courses Jurisprudence, Constitution, Criminal Law, Administrative Law, Law of Executive Accusation, Civil Law, Code of Civil Law, Commercial Law, International Private Law, International Economic Law, Criminal Procedural Law, Economic Law, Chinese Legal History, Law of Nations, Intellectual Property Law Objective This objective is to train students to obtain strong applied-oriented ability, so that students after graduation are able to work as lawyers, judges, prosecutors and legal professional personnel in administration institutions or enterprises. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Law is granted

duration.text: The Law at Sichuan Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7.Certification of no criminal record 8.Copy of insurance policy 9.Photocopies of personal artwork Those who apply for artistic major should supply materials to prove your art level.

requirements.text: 1.High school graduates 2.No criminal record 3.HSK level 3 or above
